title: Early Peanut Eating Cut Allergies To 1.9%
hook: Eating peanut early beat avoidance: allergies fell to 1.9%.
closing: The reversal matters because prevention advice can change when better evidence arrives.
question: Would you introduce peanut early?

segments.say: Peanut allergy prevalence reached 1.4%, showing the problem had more than tripled.
Early peanut eating held allergies to 1.9%, overturning the old avoidance advice.
After guidance changed, diagnoses fell to 0.45%, although this comparison alone cannot prove the cause.
